name: dockview-solid-port
description: Monorepo for dockview-solid-port: a modern SolidJS wrapper for Dockview with no React dependency
author: https://github.com/arminmajerie

scripts.publish:dockview: pnpm --filter @arminmajerie/dockview-core run build && pnpm publish --filter @arminmajerie/dockview --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:dockview-solid: pnpm --filter @arminmajerie/dockview-core run build && pnpm --filter @arminmajerie/dockview run build && pnpm publish --filter @arminmajerie/dockview-solid --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:ordered: pnpm run publish:dockview-core && pnpm run publish:dockview && pnpm run publish:dockview-solid
scripts.build:ordered: pnpm --filter @arminmajerie/dockview-core run build && pnpm --filter @arminmajerie/dockview run build && pnpm --filter @arminmajerie/dockview-solid run build && pnpm run build:example && pnpm run build:example:data-morph
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
